description: Set site-wide custom code: `head` goes before </head> and `body` before </body> on every page, on every layout. Saved as a draft; goes live with the next publish_site (on a live-mode site the dashboard publishes only the code). Never runs in the editor. ≤20,000 characters per box, stored as sent; `warnings` flags likely mistakes (unclosed <script>, <html>/<head>/<body> tags, canonical or robots tag, GA4 already connected) without rejecting. Send only the boxes you change; "" clears one. `runOn` ('live' default; 'live-and-preview' adds the editor preview) applies at once — agents limited to drafts can't set it. For tag managers (GTM), Clarity, ads pixels, chat widgets, verification tags; plain GA4/Plausible/Fathom/Umami: set_analytics_provider.

body.description: Code for before </body> on every page. "" clears it.

head.description: Code for before </head> on every page. "" clears it.

runOn.description: Where it runs: 'live' (live site only) or 'live-and-preview'. Applies at once.

name: set_custom_code
